sampleRow.Body HTML:
Hummingbird Hollow House Kit – Affordable 680 Sq Ft Bungalow Home Plan

The Hummingbird Hollow House Kit is a cozy 1-story bungalow offering 680 sq ft of well-designed living space. With 1 bedroom and 1 bathroom, it features a clean and functional floor plan, perfect as a starter home, vacation retreat, or second dwelling. Its panelized construction allows for efficient, cost-effective assembly, reducing build time by up to 60% compared to traditional methods.

Key Features

  • What’s Included: Pre-cut floor trusses, panelized walls, roof trusses, windows, exterior finishes, shingles, insulation, drywall, and delivery.
  • Customizable Floor Plans: Modify the layout to suit your personal needs and preferences.
  • Built to Last: Engineered to meet local codes for wind, snow, and hurricane resistance.

Affordable and Flexible Options

The Hummingbird Hollow kit is perfect for DIY builders or contractors. Need assistance? We can connect you with a local builder once you become our customer. Additionally, turnkey build services are available in select states—reach out for details!

Turnaround Times and Support

Due to high demand, the current turnaround time is 14 to 16 weeks from order to delivery. For questions, call us at 502-298-8946 or fill out our contact form, and we’ll respond within 24 to 48 hours.

Explore Our Expansive Selection of Home Plans

Discover our wide array of home plans, ranging from cozy cabins and tiny homes to larger layouts up to 4,750 sq ft. Find the ideal house plan to bring your dream home to life today!

As described in our Privacy Policy, we collect personal information from your interactions with us and our website, including through cookies and similar technologies. We may also share this personal information with third parties, including advertising partners. We do this in order to show you ads on other websites that are more relevant to your interests and for other reasons outlined in our privacy policy.

Sharing of personal information for targeted advertising based on your interaction on different websites may be considered "sales", "sharing", or "targeted advertising" under certain U.S. state privacy laws. Depending on where you live, you may have the right to opt out of these activities. If you would like to exercise this opt-out right, please follow the instructions below.

If you visit our website with the Global Privacy Control opt-out preference signal enabled, depending on where you are, we will treat this as a request to opt-out of activity that may be considered a “sale” or “sharing” of personal information or other uses that may be considered targeted advertising for the device and browser you used to visit our website.
